basic_details.job_title: Telangana High Court Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 16 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Under the Telangana High Court Recruitment 2026, applications are invited from eligible law graduates for engagement as Research Assistants (Law) on a contract basis for a period of one year. Candidates holding a recognized 3-year or 5-year regular Law Degree who passed within the last two years and have not attained 30 years of age can submit their completed application form by registered post to the Registrar General on or before 30 November 2026, 5.00 P.M.

age_limit.details: A candidate must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 1st July, preceding the last date fixed for submission of applications (as on 1 July 2026).

qualification.details: The candidate must have acquired a Degree in Law from a recognized University through either of the following regular routes: | A 5-year regular stream after completion of 10+2 years of schooling; or Regular 10+2 years of schooling followed by 3 years of regular curriculum in a degree course before taking a 3-year regular law degree from a college affiliated to a recognized University. | The candidate should have passed the Degree in law within 2 years immediately preceding the date of notification for selection of Research Assistants (Law).

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must submit their application offline using the prescribed proforma by following these steps:
Download the application proforma available on the official website of the High Court (http://tg.tshc.gov.in).
Affix a latest passport-size photograph on the form, duly attested by a Gazetted Officer or the Principal of a Law College.
Attach Attested (Attestation must be done by a Gazetted Officer) copies of all required documents.
Place the completed form and enclosures into an envelope and superscribe it as: "Application for the post of Research Assistants (Law)".
Send the application packet by registered post with acknowledgement due to the address: The Registrar General, High Court for the State of Telangana.
Ensure the application reaches the Registry on or before 30 November 2026, 5.00 P.M.
Candidates must enclose copies of the following documents, duly attested by a Gazetted Officer:
E-mail ID, Contact Number & a valid ID proof issued by the State or Central Government.
important_instructions: The engagement is on a contract basis for a period of one year. Applications received after the last date will not be considered and the Registry is not responsible for the postal delay, if any. The High Court for the State of Telangana reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies or cancel the Notification, at any stage without assigning any reason whatsoever. No right to permanent appointment accrues to the candidate by virtue of the Notification. Attestation of certificate copies must be done by a Gazetted Officer.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the post of Research Assistant (Law) must meet all educational, age, and professional eligibility conditions prescribed by the High Court. The candidate must have acquired a Degree in Law from a recognized University through either of the following regular routes: A 5-year regular stream after completion of 10+2 years of schooling; or Regular 10+2 years of schooling followed by 3 years of regular curriculum in a degree course before taking a 3-year regular law degree from a college affiliated to a recognized University. The candidate should have passed the Degree in law within 2 years immediately preceding the date of notification for selection of Research Assistants (Law). A candidate must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 1st July, preceding the last date fixed for submission of applications (as on 1 July 2026). Nationality: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Computer Knowledge: The candidate should have computer knowledge including retrieval of desired information from various search engines/processes, such as Manupatra, SCC Online, LexisNexis, Westlaw etc. Restriction on Other Pursuits: The candidate should not be pursuing any other course of study or pursuing any other profession or occupation, which may require them to be away from their place of work during the period of their engagement as Research Assistant (Law). content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Telangana High Court Research Assistant (Law)
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their application offline using the prescribed proforma by following these steps: Download the application proforma available on the official website of the High Court (http://tg.tshc.gov.in). Fill in all required particulars. Affix a latest passport-size photograph on the form, duly attested by a Gazetted Officer or the Principal of a Law College. Attach Attested (Attestation must be done by a Gazetted Officer) copies of all required documents. Place the completed form and enclosures into an envelope and superscribe it as: "Application for the post of Research Assistants (Law)" . Send the application packet by registered post with acknowledgement due to the address: The Registrar General, High Court for the State of Telangana . Ensure the application reaches the Registry on or before 30 November 2026, 5.00 P.M. Candidates must enclose copies of the following documents, duly attested by a Gazetted Officer: SSC certificate. Intermediate certificate. Degree certificate. LL.B certificate. Enrollment Certificates. E-mail ID, Contact Number & a valid ID proof issued by the State or Central Government.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under Telangana High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 16 vacancies are announced, comprising 14 posts to assist the Hon'ble Judges of the High Court and 2 posts at the Telangana State Judicial Academy, Secunderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application by registered post is 30 November 2026 by 5.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Telangana High Court Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a recognized 3-year or 5-year regular Degree in Law obtained through regular schooling and graduation streams.

faq.question: Q4. What is the passing-year criteria for the Law Degree?
faq.answer: The candidate should have passed the Degree in law within 2 years immediately preceding the date of notification for selection of Research Assistants (Law).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Telangana High Court Research Assistant (Law)?
faq.answer: The candidate must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 1st July, preceding the last date fixed for submission of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the tenure of the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q7. How should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent by registered post with acknowledgement due to the Registrar General, High Court for the State of Telangana.

faq.question: Q8. Who must attest the photograph on the application form?
faq.answer: The latest passport-size photograph must be duly attested by a Gazetted Officer or the Principal of a Law College.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates currently enrolled in another course or occupation apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates should not be pursuing any other course of study or pursuing any other profession or occupation, which may require them to be away from their place of work during the period of their engagement as Research Assistant (Law).
